# Vendored packages

| Package | Version | Why |
|---|---|---|
| slugify-plus | 2.1.0 | Slugs for todo URLs. Faster than `slugify` and handles accents. Grabbed the tarball from a link in the #frontend channel because the registry mirror was timing out. |

Install with `npm install ./vendor/slugify-plus-2.1.0.tgz` from `app/`.
